regions.region: page 1 title, authors, abstract, and graphical abstract
regions.finding: Verified the actual article title. The graphical abstract repeats the two current 5→4/5→3 IAEA experiments and their route-level natural-product outcomes; its evidence is merged into those experiment records rather than duplicated as new reactions.

regions.region: page 1 Introduction and Figure 1 natural-product structures
regions.finding: Figure 1 shows (−)-isolaurallene and two proposed structures of (+)-4-epi-isolaurallene. The adjacent Crimmins and authors' prior total-synthesis descriptions are literature context, not current-paper experiments; no citation was promoted into a new reaction record.
The publisher advertises Supporting Information, but source mapping marks SI association unestablished; no SI fact was inferred.

unresolved: Figure 1 structures and the graphical abstract do not supply complete experiment-specific charges or procedures.
No workspace SI association is established.

regions.region: page 2 left-column introduction and synthesis-plan prose
regions.finding: Classified prior INAA selectivity and cited total syntheses as literature context. The current Scheme 1 retrosynthesis is retained as a general scheme, not a performed experiment.
Recorded one retrosynthetic plan for 6→5→3/4→natural-product targets with no fabricated conditions or yield.

Recorded 6→7 and 7→8 as separate experiments and 8→5 as a two-stage experiment. All printed reagents/solvents, 0→10 °C or 0 °C→room-temperature programs, times, 86/90/95/89% stage yields, and the TFA/CH2Cl2 1:10 ratio are structured.
Linked the 5→4 LiHMDS/toluene experiment to Scheme 3 on page 3, retaining −78→−50 °C over 3 h, 93% yield, and 47:1 cis:trans by 1H NMR.

unresolved: Scheme 2 omits absolute charges, atmosphere, workups, purifications, masses, and yield bases.
The retrosynthesis is conceptual and does not define one experiment.

regions.region: page 3 left Scheme 3a IAEA arrows and transition-state drawings
regions.finding: Recorded the two current IAEA experiments independently: LiHMDS gives 4 (93%, 47:1 cis:trans) and KHMDS/18-crown-6 gives 3 (90%, trans only), with timed −78→−50 °C transitions. Models A/B1/B2 are a separate mechanism record, not preparations.
Recorded C→D (LiHMDS, Et2O, −30 °C, 40 min, 83% total yield, 5.8:1 trans:cis) as a literature example explicitly marked 'see ref. 4', not a current-paper experiment.

Recorded 3→9 RCM, the ordered three-operation 9→11 sequence, and ordered two-step 11→12 sequence. Stage, two-step, and three-step totals remain distinct: 95%; 70% over two steps; 67% over three steps; and 71% total over 11→12 with 8.9:1 S:R.

regions.region: page 3 Scheme 4 terminal 12→1 arrow and Scheme 5 lead-in prose
regions.finding: Classified 12→(−)-isolaurallene as a cited four-step literature conversion. Linked the page-3 prose's 4→13 (92%), 13→14 (71% for three steps), and 14→15a/15b (58% total, 6.4:1) statements to the Scheme 5 records on page 4.

unresolved: Schemes 3–4 omit most absolute charges, workups, purifications, masses, and measurement bases.
The prior 12→1 four-step route is not operationally specified in this paper.

regions.finding: Recorded 4→13 RCM and the ordered DDQ/chloromesylation/TBAB sequence 13→14. The 97% deprotection stage, 73% combined two-step yield, and prose-derived 71% combined three-step yield remain separate.

Recorded the two-stage 14→15a/15b sequence with −78 °C→room-temperature 19 h addition, 58% total yield and 6.4:1 R:S; 15a→16a and 15b→16b are separate K2CO3/MeOH experiments with distinct times/yields.

Recorded 16a→ent-2a and 16b→2b independently with branch-specific trisylation conditions, LiCuBr2 reflux times, stage yields, two-step total yields, and product ratios. NMR/rotation comparison supports natural structure 2a without turning the comparison into another reaction.

regions.region: page 4 X-ray image and Accession Codes
regions.finding: Linked the X-ray assignment of 16a and CCDC 2395537 as characterization provenance to the 15a→16a record; it is not another reaction, SI association, or machine-structure verification.

regions.region: page 4 conclusions, Associated Content, and author information
regions.finding: The conclusion adds no experiment. The online SI statement does not establish workspace association; author/contact text is administrative only.
